content_sections.heading: APCOB Apprentice Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: APCOB has notified 25 tentative training seats for Apprentices. The category-wise vacancy break-up is as follows: Abbreviations: OC – Open Competition; BC – Backward Classes; SC – Scheduled Caste (Group-I, II & III); ST – Scheduled Tribe; EWS – Economically Weaker Sections. Out of the 25 posts, the specialization-wise distribution is as follows: Reservation for Women and Persons with Benchmark Disability (PWBD) is on a horizontal basis; selected candidates are placed in their appropriate category (SC/ST/BC/Unreserved). EWS reservation is governed by A.P. G.O. MS. No. 73 dated 04.08.2021 and requires an Income and Asset Certificate from a Competent Authority. Reservation for Scheduled Castes (Sub-classification) is governed by A.P. G.O.Ms.No. 7 dated 18.04.2025. Reservation for the BC-E Group is subject to the outcome of pending litigation and related Government Orders. The number of training seats, including reserved seats, is provisional and may vary as per the Bank's actual requirement. The Bank reserves the right to enhance or reduce vacancies at the time of final selection/appointment.

content_sections.heading: APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age, and other eligibility conditions specified below before applying for the APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026. Candidates must have completed graduation and hold a valid passing certificate. Candidates must be proficient in Telugu and English (reading and writing). All eligibility conditions (age, qualification, etc.) are computed as on 01.08.2026. The candidate must not have undergone apprenticeship in any other organization, terminated an apprenticeship midway, or be currently pursuing apprenticeship training in any other bank/organization/company/firm under the Apprentices Act, 1961. Candidates with one or more years of training or job experience after completing their educational qualification are not eligible. Candidates must have a 100% complete profile on the NATS apprenticeship portal to be eligible to apply. Engagement is subject to the candidate being declared medically fit as per the Bank's requirement. Candidates who do not hold a 10th or 12th standard mark sheet showing the specified local language must clear a local language test conducted during Document Verification.

rows.educational_qualification: Bachelor's degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Science, Agricultural Engineering, Pisciculture, or Agricultural Marketing and Cooperation from a recognized University/Institute approved by the Govt. of India or its regulatory bodies.

Bachelor's degree in Electronics/Communication/Computer Science/Information Technology or its equivalent from a recognized University/Institute approved by the Govt. of India or its regulatory bodies.
Bachelor's degree in Law/LLB or its equivalent from a recognized University/Institute approved by the Govt. of India or its regulatory bodies.
Bachelor's degree in Banking, Commerce, Accounting & Audit from a recognized University/Institute approved by the Govt. of India or its regulatory bodies.

rows.age_criteria: Not earlier than 01.08.1998 and not later than 01.08.2004 (both days inclusive)

content_sections.heading: APCOB Apprentice Salary and Stipend Structure 2026
content_sections.text: Apprentices selected under this notification will receive a monthly stipend as detailed below: The Bank pays the stipend to the apprentice every month after deducting the Government's share, which is paid directly to the apprentice via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) as per Apprenticeship rules. Apprentices are not eligible for any other allowances or benefits. Apprentices are not treated as "employees" of the Bank and are not entitled to employee benefits.

content_sections.heading: APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the APCOB Apprentice program is based on a merit list prepared from academic marks, followed by document verification. The selection process includes: Registration on the NATS 2.0 portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) with a 100% complete profile. Online application submission via the APCOB website between 02.08.2026 and 11.08.2026. Scrutiny of applications received on or before the last date by a Committee appointed by the Bank. Preparation of a merit list in descending order based on marks/percentage obtained in SSC, 12th (HSC/10+2), and Graduation. In case of a tie in percentage, candidates are ranked according to age in descending order (older candidates ranked higher). Document Verification (DV) at the APCOB Head Office in Vijayawada for shortlisted candidates. Final engagement subject to satisfactory verification of character, antecedents, and caste validity certificates (wherever applicable). Selected candidates receive communication for Document Verification and, upon final selection, an email communication from APCOB. Note: Mere eligibility does not guarantee selection or vest any right to engagement. APCOB reserves the right to change or modify the selection/engagement criteria if necessary.

rows.award_of_marks: Between 70%-79% - 7 Marks; Between 60%-69% - 6 Marks; Between 50%-59% - 5 Marks; Below 50% - 4 Marks

content_sections.heading: APCOB Apprentice Required Documents
content_sections.text: Based on the notification, candidates should be ready with the following documents at the time of Document Verification: SSC, 12th (HSC/10+2), and Graduation mark sheets and passing certificates Proof of local language study (10th or 12th standard mark sheet/certificate), where applicable Caste validity certificate (wherever applicable) BC Certificate showing creamy layer status, issued between 01.04.2026 and the date of appointment (for BC category candidates) Income and Asset Certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026, in the prescribed format, for EWS category candidates Certificate for age relaxation, if claiming relaxation under SC/ST, BC (Non-Creamy Layer), or PwBD category Medical fitness certificate/certification as required by the Bank The notification does not provide an exhaustive checklist of all identity or address proof documents; candidates should refer to the official notification and any further instructions issued by APCOB before Document Verification.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies in APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: APCOB has notified 25 tentative training seats for Apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961, for FY 2026-27.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 11.08.2026. Applications opened on 02.08.2026.

faq.question: Q3. Where do candidates need to register before applying for APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must first register on the NATS 2.0 apprenticeship portal at www.nats.education.gov.in and ensure their profile is 100% complete before applying to APCOB.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 20 years and a maximum of 28 years old as on 01.08.2026, meaning they must be born between 01.08.1998 and 01.08.2004 (both dates inclusive). Age relaxation applies for SC/ST (5 years), BC-Non-Creamy Layer (3 years), and PwBD (10 years) candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly stipend for APCOB Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive a total monthly stipend of ₹15,000, comprising a maximum Bank component of ₹10,500 and a maximum Government component of ₹4,500 paid via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for APCOB Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee details. This information is not available in the notification provided.
